asset_location_check.name: asset_location_check
asset_location_check.value: (url is null) = (path is not null or blob_key is not null)

asset_stored_blob_check.name: asset_stored_blob_check
asset_stored_blob_check.value: kind not in ('video', 'transcript', 'chapters', 'captions', 'poster', 'diagram_svg') or blob_key is not null

asset_resource_type_check.name: asset_resource_type_check
asset_resource_type_check.value: resource_type is null or (kind = 'link' and resource_type in ('paper', 'docs', 'video', 'book', 'other'))

blob_object_confirmed_check.name: blob_object_confirmed_check
blob_object_confirmed_check.value: state <> 'present' or confirmed_at is not null

topic_relation_related_order_check.name: topic_relation_related_order_check
topic_relation_related_order_check.value: kind <> 'related' or from_slug collate "C" < to_slug collate "C"

mastery_counts_check.name: mastery_counts_check
mastery_counts_check.value: observations >= 0 and correct >= 0 and correct <= observations

draft_pending_topic_brief_check.name: draft_pending_topic_brief_check
draft_pending_topic_brief_check.value: pending_topic is null or brief is not null

draft_cost_source_check.name: draft_cost_source_check
draft_cost_source_check.value: cost_source is null or cost_source in ('result', 'stream')

draft_cost_source_paired_check.name: draft_cost_source_paired_check
draft_cost_source_paired_check.value: cost_source is null or cost_usd is not null

draft_error_kind_check.name: draft_error_kind_check
draft_error_kind_check.value: error_kind is null or error_kind in ('agent', 'brief-invalid', 'timeout', 'interrupted')

job_cost_source_check.name: job_cost_source_check
job_cost_source_check.value: cost_source is null or cost_source in ('result', 'stream')

job_cost_source_paired_check.name: job_cost_source_paired_check
job_cost_source_paired_check.value: cost_source is null or cost_usd is not null

job_started_at_check.name: job_started_at_check
job_started_at_check.value: started_at is null or started_at >= requested_at

job_finished_at_check.name: job_finished_at_check
job_finished_at_check.value: finished_at is null or started_at is null or finished_at >= started_at

job_queued_check.name: job_queued_check
job_queued_check.value: state <> 'queued' or (started_at is null and runner is null)

session_order_check.name: session_order_check
session_order_check.value: ended_at is null or ended_at >= started_at

catalog_instance_copy_check.name: catalog_instance_copy_check
catalog_instance_copy_check.value: role <> 'copy' or primary_host is not null

content_revision_previous_check.name: content_revision_previous_check
content_revision_previous_check.value: seq = 1 or previous_id is not null

content_source_flipped_check.name: content_source_flipped_check
content_source_flipped_check.value: source <> 'db' or flipped_at is not null
